domain_policy: real arithmetic; N is positive; every log argument needs a replayable syntactic positivity witness
rate_policy: collect rational coefficients a of direct linear a*N terms in exp arguments; q is the least positive lcm of their denominators; exp(a*N+r) rewrites to t^(-a*q)*exp(r)
nested_scale_policy: after rewriting, an exp argument with a negative t-valuation is outside the single-exponential-scale grammar
observer: exact finite limit with a positive-order residual witness; no opaque generic limit oracle
normal_form: finite Laurent/Taylor band in t with exact SymPy coefficients and explicit O(t^k)
comparison: exact comparison by t-valuation and leading coefficient inside the implemented band
cancellation: record the maximum positive jump between the least child valuation and the sum valuation
replay: receive source and context separately; rederive q, rewrite, normal form, result, residual, branch witnesses, costs, and certificate digest
claim_ceiling: exact semantic evaluation only for the frozen real single-exponential rational-rate fragment; not a general LE/transseries evaluator
